title: Baseline WASM (CPU)
notes: Original multi-threaded WASM implementation running on CPU worker threads.

title: Initial WebGPU Decoder
notes: First WebGPU decoder port with chunked prefill to keep score scratch linear.

title: GPU-Resident Decoder Weights
notes: Sharded Q8 decoder weights resident in WebGPU storage buffers; WASM heap drops to 0.68 GB.

title: GPU-Resident Audio Tower
notes: Audio encoder transformer tower moved to WebGPU; WASM heap drops to 0.33 GB.

title: Fused SwiGLU & Subgroups
notes: SwiGLU fused into gate/up matmuls, SIMD subgroup reductions for row sums, causal tiled V-sum.

title: GPU Tiled Transpose, 2-Stage Argmax, Zero-Alloc Streaming
notes: Shared-memory bank-conflict-free GPU tiled transpose, 64-way FTZ-immune argmax with pass barriers, precomputed sinusoidal PE, persistent zero-allocation streaming buffers, unified GPUDevice.
